examples.description: Remind this client only once an invoice is overdue, and write their messages in Bahasa Melayu

preconditions: reminder_cadence picks which payment reminders invoice_reminders_due lists for this client's unpaid invoices: 'standard' = 3 days before the due date, on the due date, 7 days after and 14 days after; 'from_due' = on the due date, 7 days after and 14 days after; 'overdue_only' = 7 days after and 14 days after; 'off' = none. Unset reads as 'standard'. message_language is the language invoice_message_prepare writes this client's messages in when the call names none: 'en' English, 'ms' Bahasa Melayu, 'zh' Chinese; unset reads as 'en'. Nothing is ever sent.

description: Update a invoice_client you own (optionally compare-and-set via expected_updated_at).

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at you last read. Mismatch returns CONFLICT with the current value.

name: invoice_client_update
